title: Example discovery call

prospect.situation: Made-up example so the page renders without private data. Two beds open for a month; relies on a placement agent.

objections.quote: Do you have any results you can show me?
objections.joey_response_quote: We're pretty new, but it works.
objections.better_response: Fair ask. Here's what the numbers look like for a home your size, bad case included.
Compared to what the two empty beds cost you each month?

what_moves_them: Seeing the cost of empty beds.

strong.quote: What made you take this call today?
strong.why: Open question that got the story.

weak.quote: So let me walk you through our whole system.
weak.better_line: Before I show you anything, how many families called last month?

turning_points.what: Price lands before pain is quantified.

lessons: Quantify the cost of empty beds before naming a price.
